hints.title: Exponential Doubling
hints.text: Notice that every expansion doubles the length by appending an incremented copy of the current prefix.

hints.title: Bit Position Contribution
hints.text: Each power-of-two bit set in index (k - 1) corresponds to exactly one transformation increment.

hints.title: Popcount Mapping
hints.text: The character at 1-based index k is 'a' shifted by the number of set bits (popcount) in k - 1 modulo 26.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Bit count on (K - 1) in logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Explicitly constructing the expanded string requires exponential O(K) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify Thue-Morse style bitwise popcount shift invariant.
